volatility_compression.action: Typical intra-period price range is narrow; check whether volatility has compressed structurally.

tail_dependence.action: Price distribution is dominated by rare spike periods; inspect the tail before relying on averages.

congestion_persistence.action: Long runs of zonal price separation; candidate interfaces for the where/when congestion analysis.

oversupply_risk.action: High share of negative-price periods; check for structural renewable oversupply.
